items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: Jake can't tell me who he was.

ctx.x: Yeah, I saw in a magazine... You remember when the union used to put a little magazine out? The Musicians' Union? Called the Prelude. I doubt if you remember that. But they had it in May of 1928. You were playing in Morrison's. I found that. And then it says you went with Buzzy Williams to the Slipper in October of 28. Yeah. You remember Buzzy? Oh, yeah. He's a night watchman now. Pan American Life Insurance. Last time I saw him, he was out there. I'd like to know, Buzzy. I haven't seen Buzzy Cock in a year.…

Yeah. Just like the other night there, I said, yeah, no, I'm alive about three weeks ago. Mm-hmm. I get a letter in the mail, and I open it. And it's been so long since I've seen the boy, I didn't remember his name. Jake can't tell me who he was. Mm-hmm. And somebody sends me a letter, and greetings, you know, that I let nobody else in my piano play. I used to play with Mr. Griffo. What was his name? Emmett. No. Martin. Joe Martin. Huh? Joe Martin.
